text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordan celebrates King Hussein's birthday. 61 years whose threads have woven the story of a country, its people and its leader. The king's birthday is our birthday.
- Prime Minister Kabariti says his government will immediately implement royal decree to pardon bread rioters and review bread prices.
- Speaker of Parliament Srour praises king's decree. "Jordan was and will remain a country of tolerance and honour".
- Body of slain embassy driver in Iraq returned to Jordan for burial.
- The Jordanian family celebrates King Hussein's birthday today.
- King discusses peace process with U.S. President Clinton.
- Source in Ministry of Supply says bread price decreases likely to come into effect early next year.
- King Hussein says in interview with al-Quds al-Arabi: "Our style is dialogue and our hopes are for national awakening."
- Srour appears favourite to retain speakership of house.
